items.scope: PostgreSQL SKIP LOCKED media processing queue replaced by Cloudflare Queues media/readmodel lifecycle
items.proof: Worker production configuration binds MEDIA_QUEUE to ikimon-prod-media-jobs. Worker-native observation photo/video finalize paths enqueue media.process and readmodel.refresh jobs, and the queue consumer refreshes media/readmodel state. The Node PostgreSQL SKIP LOCKED processor and CLI have been removed, and production media smoke no longer starts a VPS PG media worker.
items.nextProofRequired: Keep Cloudflare Queue bindings and consumer deploy checks in place before VPS shutdown.

items.scope: PostgreSQL LISTEN/NOTIFY live observation-event fanout replaced by snapshot/polling event delivery
items.proof: Worker production observation event APIs already serve D1-native recent/live snapshot routes with x-ikimon-observation-event-live-mode=snapshot-only. Node origin SSE now emits only the initial snapshot and relies on the existing client polling fallback, removing PG LISTEN/NOTIFY fanout.
items.nextProofRequired: Use Durable Objects or Worker-native push only if true real-time fanout becomes product-critical again.
